headline: Approved $60,435 Fletcher Free Library renovation contract; recommended $558,500 water fund use and $741,500 insurance renewal.
summary: Members adopted a consent agenda covering an insurance renewal, bond refunding, and two grants, which were recommended to the City Council. Members also approved a $60,435 construction contract for the Fletcher Free Library renovation and recommended using $558,500 of water fund balance for drinking water projects.
decisions: Approved minutes of the October 5, 2026 meeting as part of the consent agenda, passed unanimously.
Recommended City Council approve the Property, Boiler and Machinery insurance renewal with a not to exceed premium of $741,500, passed unanimously as part of the consent agenda.
Recommended City Council approve the General Obligation Refunding Bonds resolution, passed unanimously as part of the consent agenda.
Recommended City Council accept the DCF State Grant #03440-29000-27 in the amount of $230,450.02, passed unanimously as part of the consent agenda.
Recommended City Council accept VOCA Grant # 02160-VOCA23-4009608-2027 in the amount of $140,164 for FY27, passed unanimously as part of the consent agenda.
Recommended City Council authorize use of up to $558,500 of Fund 460 Drinking Water fund balance for drinking water planning projects, passed unanimously.
Approved a Construction Manager at Risk contract with ReArch Construction, not to exceed $60,435, for the Fletcher Free Library renovation, passed unanimously.

Subject 4.3. Approval Needed For Fletcher Free Library Transformational 
Renovation Project Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) with ReArch 
Construction  
    
Meeting October 26, 2026 - Board of Finance Meeting - Monday, October 26, 2026, 5:00 
PM, Bushor Conference Room, 149 Church Street, 1st Floor  
  
Category 4. Deliberative Agenda 
  
  
Department Fletcher Free Library 
  
Type Action 
 
    
Recommended Action to approve and authorize the execution of a Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) 
contract and any related documents with ReArch Construction for preconstruction 
and bidding services for the Fletcher Free Library Transformational Renovation 
Project in an amount not to exceed $60,435.00; and to authorize the Library 
Director, or her designee, to execute the contract and related documents, subject 
to final review and approval of the City Attorney’s Office. The contract shall 
preserve the City’s right to discontinue ReArch’s services in accordance with the 
termination provisions of the final agreement if the City determines that ReArch’s 
performance is unsatisfactory or that continuation is not in the City’s best interest. 
Additionally, to approve and authorize the establishment of a project expenditure 
budget of $60,435.00 to support the costs associated with this contract, with 
funding provided entirely by the Friends of the Fletcher Free Library through 
quarterly payments to the City in accordance with the approved Capital Campaign 
Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)  
     
4.3. Approval Needed For Fletcher Free Library Transformational Renovation Project Construction Manager at 
Risk (CMAR) with ReArch Construction
